name: SAVA 萨瓦 A7 / A7L 2026
why_interesting: The retained official-store 2026 A7L card is a second dated observation of the published SAVA A7L R7100, now bridged to the current R08 T800 and mixed SENSAH/Shimano specification.
missing: Current mainland warranty route and final checkout conditions

facts.complete_weight: Manufacturer page claims approximately 8.6 kg for the R08-R7120-24S build shown with 50 mm carbon wheels; weight varies by size and weighing basis is unstated. The retained card does not resolve its selected wheel option, so this is not assigned as its complete weight.
facts.drivetrain: Current page labels the build R08-R7120-24S and lists SENSAH HRD 2x12 hydraulic controls/brakes with Shimano 105 R7100 derailleurs, FC-PR6-B1 50/34, CS-R9012 11-34 and S-X12R chain. EMPIRE PRO is not confirmed by the page.
facts.tire_clearance: 25C manufacturer maximum for the exact R08 frame
facts.frame_material: T800 carbon R08 frame, fork and seatpost; layup and molding process are not stated.
facts.frame_stiffness: Manufacturer qualitative rigidity/lightweight improvement claim; no numeric protocol
facts.stiffness_evidence: An earlier manufacturer page, checked 2026-09-01, described a qualitative rigidity/lightweight improvement. The current 2026-09-24 product-page check does not repeat a stiffness claim; no numeric stiffness result or public protocol is available.

source_note: The 2026-09-24 official-page recheck confirms the exact A7L R08-R7120-24S configuration, approximate size-variable weight, listed drivetrain and T800 construction. The manufacturer compatibility guide separately states a conservative 25C maximum for the R08 frame; the page’s 25C fitted tire is not used as maximum evidence. The product-page weight is shown with 50 mm carbon wheels and is not assigned to the retained card while its selected wheel option remains unknown.
